chapter: Opening and the Buddy Petit band
title: Buddy Petit's tone, low-register style and derby mute
summary: Zardis describes Petit as a low-register player rather than a high-note man, his looks, his cornet and his famous derby mute that other trumpeters adopted.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
